columns.name: movieid
columns.description: The unique identifier of the movie.

columns.name: actor_with_longest_screentime
columns.description: The actor with the longest screentime in the movie, with ties broken by the ascending order of the actor name.

columns.name: percentage_of_the_USA_actors
columns.description: The percentage of the actors born in the USA that showed up in the credit list of the movie

columns.name: percentage_of_the_actor_born_after_19700101
columns.description: The percentage of actors in the movie's credit list whose date of birth is valid and after 1970-01-01.

columns.name: num_distinct_characters
columns.description: The number of distinct characters in the movie, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_USA_male_actors
columns.description: The number of male actors born in USA that starred in the movie, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: actorid
columns.description: The unique identifier of the actor.

columns.name: networth
columns.description: The net worth of the actor

columns.name: number_of_movies
columns.description: The number of movies the actor has acted in, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: average_rating_of_all_the_movies
columns.description: The average rating of all the movies the actor has acted in

columns.name: number_of_movie_with_a_rating_greater_than_5
columns.description: The number of movies the actor has acted in that has a rating greater than 5, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_romantic_movies
columns.description: The number of movies in the genre 'Romance' the actor has acted in, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: total_runtime_of_the_movie_with_a_rating_greater_than_7
columns.description: The total runtime of the movies the actor has acted in that has a rating greater than 7, replace NULL values with 0.

config:
Airbyte:
  config:
    mongodb_definition_id: b2e713cd-cc36-4c0a-b5bd-b47cb8a0561e

    server_url: http://airbyte-abctl-control-plane:80/api/public/v1/
    snowflake_definition_id: 424892c4-daac-4491-b35d-c6688ba547ba
aws_s3:
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: test
  AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-west-2
  AWS_ENDPOINT_URL: http://elt-localstack:4566
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: test
  data:
  - path: s3://movie-bucket/characters.jsonl
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    table: characters
mongodb:
  config:
    connection_string: mongodb://elt-mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true
    database: movie
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - actor
postgres:
  config:
    database: movie
    host: elt-postgres
    password: testelt
    port: 5432
    schema: public
    sync_mode: full_refresh_append
    tables:
    - movies
    user: postgres
snowflake:
  config:
    database: movie
    password: Snowflake@123
    role: AIRBYTE_ROLE
    schema: AIRBYTE_SCHEMA
    username: AIRBYTE_USER
    warehouse: AIRBYTE_WAREHOUSE
